params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: rowPosition
params.description: Number of the row to select.

params.name: action
params.description: Selection action to apply when a row/break selection already exists.

sentinelValues.meaning: lk replace selection (default): the new selection replaces the existing selection, like a user click (no On Clicked event fired).
lk add to selection: adds to the existing selection.
lk remove from selection: removes from the existing selection.

overloads.semanticRole: Selects the given row of the designated list box, combining it with any existing selection per the action parameter.

constraints: If rowPosition < 0, the command does nothing regardless of action.
If rowPosition is 0 with action omitted or lk replace selection, all rows are selected; with lk remove from selection, all rows are deselected.
If rowPosition exceeds the row count of an array-type list box, the underlying Boolean array is resized and the action is applied only if that resize actually grows the source array.
